entries.name: field
entries.description: The column from which we want to filter the rows.

entries.name: id
entries.description:
Must be unique.
Only useful when the model contains several items.

entries.name: logicOperator
entries.description:
- `GridLogicOperator.And`: the row must pass all the filter items.
- `GridLogicOperator.Or`: the row must pass at least on filter item.
